# BeatGig — account brief

## Who

BeatGig is a live music booking platform connecting artists with venues, colleges, and private events ([source](https://beatgig.com/)). Its GitHub org lists beatgig.com as its website ([source](https://github.com/beatgig)).

## Production Expo signals

- `eas.json` is present in `beatgig/beatgig-mobile` ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/eas.json))
- `package.json` in `beatgig/beatgig-mobile` pins react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/package.json))
- The `beatgig` org has 6 public repos and 22 followers ([source](https://github.com/beatgig))
- The BeatGig app has 1,800 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972))
- 2 App Store releases shipped in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972))

## Who to talk to

- Maintainer One (@beatgig-maintainer-1), 88 commits, top contributor to `beatgig/beatgig-mobile` ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-1)). Profile lists company "BeatGig", location "Remote", website https://beatgig.com, and bio "Mobile engineer at BeatGig. Maintains the BeatGig app (Expo / React Native)." ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-1))
- Maintainer Two (@beatgig-maintainer-2), 19 commits, top contributor to `beatgig/beatgig-mobile` ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-2)). Profile lists company "BeatGig", location "New York, NY", website https://beatgig.com, and bio "React Native developer on the BeatGig mobile team. EAS builds and releases for the BeatGig app." ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-2))

## Why now

`beatgig/beatgig-mobile` was last pushed 2026-06-30 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile)), and the app shipped 2 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)). The repo runs react-native ~0.73.6 ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/package.json)).

## Suggested opener

Maintainer Two, your profile says you handle EAS builds and releases for the BeatGig app ([source](https://github.com/beatgig-maintainer-2)). The repo has an `eas.json` ([source](https://github.com/beatgig/beatgig-mobile/blob/main/eas.json)) and the app shipped 2 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/beatgig/id1524340972)). When you cut those two releases, what part of the build and submit pipeline took the most hands-on time?
